text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$1.50 higher on CBOT soyoil and soymeal calls with technical resistance seen in the July at $425.50, resistance at $423. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -7.05 Tuesday from -11.02 Monday. Canada's dollar was weaker at C$1.3858 versus the U.S. dollar and fell to 85.44 Japanese Yen and rose to 1.2288 German Marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 up in the July with support seen from allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn, wheat and WCE barley calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
